name: @eigenwife/overlay
description: Eve on the real desktop: a transparent, click-through Electron window around the shell's ?mode=overlay.

scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external electron --outfile dist/main.cjs && bun build src/preload.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external electron --outfile dist/preload.cjs && bun build src/cursor/preload.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external electron --outfile dist/cursor-preload.cjs && bun build src/cursor/renderer.ts --target=browser --format=iife --outfile dist/cursor/renderer.js && cp src/cursor/index.html dist/cursor/index.html
scripts.start: bun run build && bun run ensure-electron && electron .
